verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in debugging agent. Users can hand it work: Autofix scans incoming issues, finds root causes, automates triage, generates code fixes and opens PRs. Seer Agent also answers questions about the application, and the Sentry Agent can be assigned Linear issues. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's delegated task execution, in-depth documentation of delegation scope and controls (approval steps, limits) beyond short feature summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage. PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Catch critical issues before you merge and fix them when they hit prod with Seer, our debugging agent and code reviewer.
Assign Sentry Agent to Linear issues, debug with Seer.
